events.subtitle: A WhatsApp invitation, printable decorations and a party-favor storybook for the guests, all with the same character.

1.title: Pick the theme (1 minute)
1.text: And the birthday child's name. With or without a photo.

2.title: See the free sample
2.text: We design the character and its mini storybook, and you approve it before paying.

3.title: Download instantly
3.text: Print at home or at the print shop you prefer, as many copies as guests.

1.q: Does each guest get a different story?
1.a: No: everyone gets the same mini storybook, approved by you. That is faster and cheaper.

2.q: How do I print and assemble it?
2.a: Everything comes as a print-ready PDF for home or the print shop you prefer. Afterwards you can order printed invitations and thank-yous shipped to your home.

3.a: No. You can choose the character's features without uploading any photo.

4.a: Since it is digital, you download the files instantly. Order a few days ahead so you can print the pieces wherever you like.

5.q: How many copies can I print?
5.a: The number you choose when buying, up to 200 per piece. The quantity does not change the price.

professionals.metaTitle: Personalized stories for educators, therapists and specialists
professionals.metaDescription: Create personalized stories for every child you support, with educational collections and tailored reading, from one account.
professionals.title: A story for every child you support
professionals.subtitle: Stories that work on emotions, routines or reading, with the child as the hero. You use an alias: we never ask for a last name or clinical data.
professionals.note: You can see the examples without an account. You need one to create and save your projects for each child.
professionals.imageAlt: Overhead view of a therapist's desk: a professional's hands hold an open book next to a tablet with a list of patients, sticky notes and colored pencils.

1.title: Create your account
1.text: One account for all your projects and purchases.

2.title: Choose a collection
2.text: Reading, feelings, achievements or first experiences, with general goals.

3.title: Personalize for each child
3.text: Use an alias and adjust the length, amount of text and reading level.

1.title: Educational collections
1.text: Stories to learn, recognize feelings, celebrate achievements and prepare for new experiences.

2.title: Tailored reading
2.text: Length, amount of text and reading level, each set separately.

3.title: Minimal child data
3.text: An alias instead of a full name, no-photo mode and no clinical data.

4.title: You adjust the text
4.text: Before paying, you edit the text of every page, see the cover and the first illustrated pages, and can try another illustration. You also get a notice that this is educational, not clinical, material.

professionals.disclaimer: StoryNido offers supportive stories. It is not a clinical system, does not replace professional judgment, and never asks for diagnoses or clinical records.

1.q: Can I create stories for different children?
1.a: Yes. Each story is an independent project in your account, identified by an alias.

2.q: Do I need photos of the children?
2.a: No. We recommend no-photo mode. If you use a photo, you need permission from the parent or guardian.

3.q: Can I match the text to the child’s level?
3.a: Yes: you choose the amount of text and the reading level, independently of the book’s length.

4.a: Yes, for repeat purchases from your account. We’ll publish the details when payments are enabled.

5.a: Yes. Before paying, you can change the text of every page in the preview. The preview illustrates the cover and the first pages, and you can try another illustration there.

6.a: No. You pay for each story and, if you make many, your account gets volume discounts. For clinics and institutions that need larger quantities, write to us from Contact.

printGuide.title: How to print your kit
printGuide.tip1: Paper: A4 or Letter, whichever you chose. For the invitation and the thank-you card, 200 to 250 gsm card stock works best.
printGuide.tip2: When printing choose “actual size” or “100%”. If the program fits the page, the crop marks move.
printGuide.tip3: Cut along the marks. Stickers and tags can be printed on self-adhesive paper.
printGuide.tip4: The WhatsApp invitation is a PNG image: save it to your phone and send it as a photo.
